caption: The drawing depicts a single green glass bottle against a plain, off-white background. The bottle has a curved, elongated body that narrows at the shoulders and leads to a short, straight neck with a pronounced lip at the top. The glass exhibits varying shades of green with areas of lighter and darker gradient, suggesting the effect of light and shadow on a reflective surface. Embossed text is visible on the front of the bottle, following the curves of its surface. The text reads "WILLINGTON GLASS Co EAST WILLINGTON" arranged in an arc near the top, a horizontal line through the center, and another arc near the bottom. The composition is centered, with the bottle vertically aligned in the middle of the image, and there are no other objects or embellishments present in the frame.
title: Glass Bottle
